questionnaire.question_text: Which task would you enjoy more?

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under tablet and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; faint dot-grid texture on printed chart paper via 3 rows max
art_style.mood: curious analytical energy — approachable data-nerd hobby, not corporate trading floor
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
readable text, numbers, or ticker symbols

accent.name: KursoKo deep violet
accent.use: selected candlestick bars, stylus tip band, sweater cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: teal
secondary.use: upward trend line, magnifying glass rim accent

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint cool #F0F4FF highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: violet appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on tablet corner and magnifying lens glass
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under tablet and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: holds a printed chart sheet flat against the desk edge
left_hand.grip: flat palm and splayed fingers pinning the paper corner
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: traces an ascending zigzag trend line on the tablet with a stylus
right_hand.grip: precision pen grip, stylus tip touching screen

pose.gesture_summary: mid-analysis freeze frame — stylus mid-stroke on a rising trend
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: folded, resting on desk beside tablet — not worn on a face

subject.choice_label: Analyzing patterns in stock market data
subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands cross-references a printed candlestick chart against a live trend line on a tablet, magnifying glass poised over a cluster of highlighted bars. The desk is otherwise bare, keeping focus on the moment of spotting a pattern. The scene reads as quiet analytical discovery, not a chaotic trading floor.

primary_objects.name: tablet with candlestick chart
primary_objects.detail: lavender-tinted screen with abstract candlestick bars and one violet highlighted cluster

primary_objects.name: printed chart sheet
primary_objects.size_relative: medium — held flat by left hand
primary_objects.detail: faint dot-grid lines with a hand-drawn teal trend curve, no readable numbers

primary_objects.name: magnifying glass
primary_objects.detail: circular lens subtly enlarging one bar cluster

primary_objects.name: stylus
primary_objects.detail: violet tip band, resting against tablet glass

depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: tablet silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter I, ticker symbols, readable numbers, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, trading floor crowd, guns, blood
